C0299.title: Adversarial Defense Against Bandwidth Depletion DDoS Attacks
C0299.summary: This study investigates defense mechanisms against bandwidth depletion DDoS attacks using adversarial methods. Bandwidth depletion attacks flood the victim's network with massive unwanted traffic, exhausting network bandwidth resources and preventing legitimate traffic from reaching the target system.
